summary: Sanders County, MT lookout near Thompson Falls: a 40-foot L-4 tower built in 1932, manned into 1955, destroyed 1963; no site description found.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1963 per firelookout.com; montanalookouts marks it Removed with no date

staffing.status: manned in newspaper-reported seasons 1934 to 1955; no later staffing record found

facts.agency: Cabinet National Forest in a 1936 item; firelookout.com lists Lolo National Forest

events.note: Telephone line started from Lookout Peak to Table Top Mountain on July 27 (newspaper item quoted on montanalookouts)
John Previs named as lookout in July; Berlin Luke to take over until the end of the fire season
Muggs Huff off the peak after a sprained neck; George Jewett from Noxon replaced him
Tom Spolar manned the lookout before the main fire danger season
Kurt Whitaker posted; the paper calls Table Top the seventh and final lookout manned in the Thompson Falls ranger district

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief says Cabinet National Forest. A 1936 item uses that name, the montanalookouts header gives Cabinet and then Lolo, and firelookout.com lists Lolo only. The brief is supported by the 1936 item but does not show the later name.

firelookout.com dates the destruction to 1963; montanalookouts says Removed with no date. Both agree the tower is gone. The story uses the 1963 date from firelookout.com and says the other source gives none.

sources.title: Table Top Mtn. Fire Lookout Tower
Table Top Mountain, Forest Lookouts Montana

notes_for_editor: Two history sites and one listing; no NHLR or FFLOS registration. The newspaper items are read only as quoted on the montanalookouts page, not from the original papers. Site condition and public access are not documented in any source read, so the story does not describe the site today. The 1931 telephone line is kept as context.
